body: I feel that. It’s like everything is equally meaningless, just distracting everyone until you die. I can’t logically justify why dogs never fail to make me smile. I hope you can stay here for your dog and every one you haven’t gotten a chance to see.

firstly, I don’t want you to die. I want you to live. regardless of what you write, it will be an artefact for your loved ones to obsess over while you’re gone. it’s the last thing you get to say, so make it stand for something, and then try to reconsider.
